SECURITY ADVISORY (1/5)                 
========================================
> CVE-2026-114713                       
  UnrealIRCd: Command Injection         
                                        
  CISA added an UnrealIRCd delimiter    
  flaw to its KEV catalog. The bug      
  enables users in linked multi-server  
  setups to inject arbitrary server-to- 
  server commands with elevated         
  privileges without auth.
